notes.title: 6.1.0 just arrived!
notes.notes:
The new version is here, with an updated logo and new artwork by Lumiantix!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38213727/6e8ccc9251f80f1e2ed517613257562c9637eed8.png[/img]

[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Equipment.
[*] New Upgrades.
[*] New Quests.
[*] New Enemies evolutions.
[*] New Village content.
[*] New Armory Items.
[*] New Ascension Upgrades.
[*] New Material and Craftable Items.
[*] New Stuff.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Materials UI reworked.
[*] Some particle effects have been improved.
[*] Ascending Heights assets reworked.
[*] Bonus Stage Goblins design reworked.
[*] On UA 2, you unlock the feature of buying all available Ascension Upgrades.
[*] Added Current Armory Bonuses in the Armory Tab to get an overview of your total Armory bonuses.
[*] Added Sword damages in stats.
[*] Bug fixes.
[*] Performance improvements.
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Equipment Upgrades are now multiplicative. Upgrades values have been adjusted to fit this change.
[*] Base Portal cooldown is now 4hs. Subsequent Portal Upgrades are now 2hs and 1hs.
[*] Mt. Otto Ascending Heights distance changed from 1200 to 800.
[*] Base Ascending Heights distance from 1500 to 1000.
[*] Anubis Guardian HP increased from 150 to 190 and Armored HP from 50 to 60.
[*] Jade Hills Giant HP increased from 66 to 140 and Armored HP from 15 to 40.
[*] Rage Mode will now deal your current sword damage multiplied by 12 to any enemy. This means that if you don't have the required damage to kill an enemy at once, you'll damage it but not kill it. This stat will be shown in the stats panel as "Rage Mode Damage".
[*] Total Sale Ascension Upgrade will now only apply to upgrades that which base cost is 1 St or less.
[*] Gem Buyer Ascension Skill now has a 25% chance to trigger.
[*] Corrupted Demon has no Armored HP. 
[/list]

notes.title: 6.0.0 is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Idle Slayer x Attack On Titan Announced![/h1]

[b]Collaboration starts on July 1st![/b]

[previewyoutube=tUYjMLD4G6c;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Collab[/h2]
[list]
[*] Attack On Titan.
[/list]
[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Craftable Items.
[*] New Upgrades.
[*] New Quests.
[*] New Achievements.
[*] New Armory Items.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added progress bar to Ascending Heights Minigame.
[*] Added News button where you can read ⁠Discord announcements channel directly from the game.
[*] Frozen Fields background updated.
[*] Slayers Lounge Leaderboards temporarily disabled.
[*] Bulk buy buttons will appear after ascending for the first time.
[*] Anna's vambraces removed.
[*] Icon appears when Landscape is locked, like in Bonus Stages or other minigames.
[*] Added Duration stat to the Rage Mode's stats section.
[*] Inner Power has a now a better explanation.
[*] Added small icon to the Quick Tool Belt which indicates if the Special Drink from Edenor's Tavern is available.
[*] Minor UI changes.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] OMG Random Event from the Random Box will now grant 10% of your Current Ascension Coins Record. Silver Random Box will grant 15%.
[*] Dark Projectiles bonus changed from 100% to 60%. (don't worry, there's a new Upgrade that increases 25% the Bow Souls bonus at bow Lv. 500 which multiplied ends up being the same)
[*] Electro Shot Skill now applies 3 damage to nearby enemies instead of 1.
[*] Stone of Idle's slay enemies while offline minimum increased from 0.9% to 2.1%
[*] Binoculars price decreased.
[*] Frozen Shards base bag capacity reduced from 200 to 150.
[*] At least one Upgrade is guaranteed to spawn when the 3 Perfect Chests are generated.
[*] Ascension Upgrades: Some prices went up, some went down.
[*] Soul Reaper II effect changed to a 25% Soul Bonus. It's basically the same and players can easily understand it. 
[/list]

notes.title: 5.1.0 Released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38213727/be73bee959757925155001b22555a1fdf31c6c1d.png[/img]

Haven't you seen the trailer yet? Take a look! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=upTzPbHy8AM
Some details of the upcoming event:
[list]
[*] The event starts on November 1st 00:00 UTC and ends on December 1st 00:00 UTC.
[*] The Shovel Knight outfit will only be available to purchase during the collaboration.
[*] Temporary Craftable Items won't work with the special Shovel Knight Quests.
[/list]

[b]This update has no support with old versions of the game. So if you are planning to play on multiple devices, make sure both versions are updated to 5.1.0.[/b]

[h2]New Feature[/h2]
[list]
[*] Coimbo Mode.
[*] Bestiary.
[/list]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Material (Players will get this Material retroactively).
[*] New Armory Items.
[*] New Achievements.
[*] New Ascension Upgrades.
[*] New Upgrades.
[*] New Casino Rewards.
[*] New Craftable Items.
[*] New Dark Divinity.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Casino Rewards will be visible even if the player doesn't meet the requirements to purchase them.
[*] When dragging an item in the Armory, the Break Item button will change the text and show how many Divinities Points and Scrap you get from breaking the item.
[*] Bat Wing sprite updated.
[*] A button dialog will show up for the first 10 Giants to teach the player they can quickly kill them by tapping/clicking the screen.
[*] Casino timeout requests increased from 6 to 8 seconds.
[*] Giants Souls Multiplier and Enemy Types Soul Multiplier were not applying to the idle soul gains. Now they will apply.
[*] CpS Achievements Icons updated.
[*] Boss name will show up when starting a Boss Fight.
[*] Boss Fight Song Remastered by Al&.
[*] Performance and loading times improved.
[*] Some Boss Fights can be retried by using a few Jewels of Soul.
[*] Individual enemy kill count will start to be registered from now on.
[*] Lighting improved in some areas.
[*] Camera system reworked. Cutscenes are now smoother.
[*] Player will face the point of interest after interacting with them.
[*] The audio sliders in the Options are now linear. You know how before, when you'd change them from 1% to 2%, the difference was huge? But then when you'd go from 90% to 100%, the volume barely changed? Yeah, that's fixed.
[*] Forgot password email is now sent from @idleslayer.com.
[*] Added flags to the Language Selector.
[*] Funky Space and Casino song loop updated.
[*] Added a one-time purchase per ascension to purchase x10 and x50 coins in the Jewels of Soul tab.
[*] New Daily Quests based on the player's progress.
[*] You can now activate Random Boxes using the Wind Dash Ability if you go through them.
[*] You can now apply multiple USP to a Stone of Time at once.
[*] Slayers' Casino renamed to Slayers' Lounge.
[*] Minor visual updates and UI changes.
[*] Bug fixes.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Random Box and Chest Hunt Key spawn timer will now be frozen during Battle Mode.
[*] Ninja reward decreased from 1% to 0.8% per level.
[*] Inner Power now works differently: It uses the spent Slayer Points in your current Ascension to calculate the Minions reward. 
[*] V coins pattern removed.
[*] Wind Dash passively increases Magnet radius by 35%.
[*] Astral Locked Ascension Upgrades won't let you buy the next Ascension Upgrade if they are not active. 
[/list]

[h2]Offline Kills Reworked[/h2]
[list]
[*] Performance highly improved when starting up the game.
[*] Enemy Type Soul modifiers were not being applied. Now they do.
[*] Kill Shiny Enemies Quests are now completed offline.
[/list]

This update introduces a Casino feature, Catalan language support, and a lot of new content including materials, craftable items, armory gear, enemy evolutions, achievements, quests, upgrades, and ascension upgrades. Experience improved visuals, faster gameplay, and a more balanced challenge with various enhancements and bug fixes.

[u][b]New Feature[/b][/u]
Village Casino. Note: This is a unique feature of the game which is server-side to prevent "luck" manipulation. This means two things:
1. Players need to have a Cloud Save account in order to access here.
2. This Casino won't work without internet connection.

[u][b]New Language[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Catalan added.
[/list]

[u][b]New Content[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] New Material.
[*] New Craftable Items.
[*] New Armory Items.
[*] New Enemy Evolutions.
[*] New Achievements.
[*] New Quests.
[*] New Upgrades.
[*] New Ascension Upgrades.
[/list]

[u][b]Improvements[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Some particles, like the purple ones when you get a new Slayer Points, are now in the UI level, instead of the "world" level. This is how it was intended since day one, but I never found a way to fix that until now.
[*] Added anime speed lines to the Rage Mode.
[*] Added A LOT of Particles.
[*] (Mobile) Added button in Options to report ads in-game.
[*] Cracking Eggs fast forward is twice as fast.
[*] Chaining Rage Modes will skip the Rage Mode initiating sequence.
[*] Armory Chest of Defense renamed to Armory Chest of Armors.
[*] Perfect Chest Hunt animation and sound updated.
[*] Connection timeout handling improved.
[*] (Mobile) App notification updated.
[*] Minor changes and bug fixes.
[/list]

[u][b]Balance[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Jade Hills Giant soul drop changed from 240 to 330.
[*] Funky Speaker Upgrade price decreased from 2e+61 to 2e+58.
[*] The player cannot craft Permanent Craftable Items that unlock equipment related Upgrades if they don't have the equipment already unlocked. For example, you won't be able to craft the Earth Gloves if you haven't unlocked the Gloves.
[*] A minimum of 2 multipliers are always guaranteed to spawn during Chest Hunt.
[*] Ascendant Badge Boost decreased from 70% to 60%.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]

[*] Chest Hunt will now display the current Savers at the bottom of the screen.
[*] Portal Dominum will now show an approximate tier indicator of how much souls/coins you could get from the dimension based on your current evolutions, enemy unlocks and unlocked dimensions.
[*] Added scroll bar on Chest Hunt when playing on Portrait.
[*] (Steam) All Achievements have been added to Steam.
[*] (Steam) The unlocked mobile only achievements will be carried to Steam, but they won't show up in the list if you don't have them.
[*] Custom sounds for Legendary and Astral Ascension Upgrades.
[*] Modern City redesigned.
[*] Modern City song updated.
[*] Dark Wraith sprite updated.
[*] Jade Hills' Giant sprite updated.
[*] Hills' Giant eye corrected.
[*] Hills song updated.
[*] Some Agnis animations have been updated.
[*] Minor changes.
[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Mill and Tavern requirements decreased.
[*] Astral Slayer price decreased from 750M to 500M.
[*] Sacred Tome of Death Pact price decreased from 75T to 10T.
[*] Sucker Punch Upgrade price decreased.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enemies' blood or explosion animation won't be shiny if the enemy was shiny.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
